name: QUIZ NIGHT
comment: White picks the sound, grey plays it. Chime and buzzer cut your voice so they land clean; applause and walk-on halve it so you can talk over them. Orange: HOST for the rounds, TANNOY for announcements. Needs firmware 1.0.9+ for duck.

presets.name: HOST
presets.comment: rumble cut, a little presence; squeeze for more cut-through. the sounds play clean after the eq.

presets.name: TANNOY
presets.comment: a horn speaker for announcements; squeeze to push the voice harder into it. the sounds stay clean.
